Shared target oracle interfaces and game codecs

Trusted in part. Every ReductionDsl reduction in Computational/Specifications/ accesses target challenger oracles and source security games through the op-free Iface and GameCodec projections in this file over atomicSig (AtomicOps.lean) and coin-only uniform samplers (Samplers.lean). Three leaf primitive interfaces (aes256PrfIface, hmacPrfIface, and leafSigAndDdhIface) are staged for Phase 1B leaf-assumption wiring; see Computational/docs/TRUSTED_BASE.md.

Adapted in part from earlier leaf challenger interface definitions by Charles Sutton, paired here with concrete ReductionDsl syntactic step, query, and 32-byte block-size budgets.

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace ReductionDsl
open OracleSpec OracleComp
open CryptoVerification CryptoVerification.E2E CryptoVerification.LibsignalProtoCodec
open CryptoGames
open Ratchet LibsignalInst LibsignalSession LibsignalSessionApi HMAC HKDF CBC LibsignalAead MACScheme SM CKA FSAEAD PRFPRNG WireAEAD AEADScheme
